MPV SDR compatibility runtime (mpv-android 2026-09-17)
Copyright the mpv, mpv-android, FFmpeg and libplacebo contributors.
Distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later with the GPL-3.0 Yingxi application.
The original shared libraries are unmodified. Their APK entry names are prefixed
for packaging, then restored inside an isolated native linker namespace.
The separate Java JNI bridge is distributed as source in third_party/mpv-bridge.

Exact source revisions, official immutable APK digest, dependency list and build
recipe are recorded in mpv-runtime.json. The official build scripts pin sources
for FFmpeg, libplacebo, libass, dav1d, libxml2, fontconfig, freetype, fribidi,
harfbuzz, libunibreak, Lua, curl and mbedtls. Their upstream license notices and
corresponding sources are available in the pinned source/build recipe.
https://github.com/mpv-android/mpv-android/tree/fdf74f6830c47dbaa8a22ac79726e8303f1db5af
https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/tree/0b7ed670f7c353dd3dd4f8ae0fc788a181a15aa6
https://github.com/haasn/libplacebo/tree/3330a515d62139259c26239014f286e233bd3a5c
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/094a2f8a2a5e7fa64736e067de224ce28fdf5979
